title: RigSpecifications
description: The specifications or configuration of the rig over a period of time. Use with the Rig.2.0.0 or later schema.

id.description: Previously called ResourceID or SRN which identifies this OSDU resource object without version.
id.title: Entity ID

kind.description: The schema identification for the OSDU resource object following the pattern {Namespace}:{Source}:{Type}:{VersionMajor}.{VersionMinor}.{VersionPatch}. The versioning scheme follows the semantic versioning, https://semver.org/.
kind.title: Entity Kind

version.description: The version number of this OSDU resource; set by the framework.
version.title: Version Number

acl.description: The access control tags associated with this entity.
acl.title: Access Control List

legal.description: The entity's legal tags and compliance status. The actual contents associated with the legal tags is managed by the Compliance Service.
legal.title: Legal Tags

tags.title: Tag Dictionary
tags.description: A generic dictionary of string keys mapping to string value. Only strings are permitted as keys and values.

createTime.description: Timestamp of the time at which initial version of this OSDU resource object was created. Set by the System. The value is a combined date-time string in ISO-8601 given in UTC.
createTime.title: Resource Object Creation DateTime

createUser.title: Resource Object Creation User Reference
createUser.description: The user reference, which created the first version of this resource object. Set by the System.

modifyTime.description: Timestamp of the time at which this version of the OSDU resource object was created. Set by the System. The value is a combined date-time string in ISO-8601 given in UTC.
modifyTime.title: Resource Object Version Creation DateTime

modifyUser.title: Resource Object Version Creation User Reference
modifyUser.description: The user reference, which created this version of this resource object. Set by the System.

ancestry.description: The links to data, which constitute the inputs, from which this record instance is derived.
ancestry.title: Ancestry

meta.description: The Frame of Reference meta data section linking the named properties to self-contained definitions.
meta.title: Frame of Reference Meta Data

RigID.title: Rig ID
RigID.description: Identifier of the Rig this specification applies to

EffectiveStartDate.title: Effective Start Date
EffectiveStartDate.description: The start date when this rig specification is valid.

EffectiveEndDate.title: Effective End Date
EffectiveEndDate.description: The end date when this rig specification is  valid.

OwnerID.title: Owner ID
OwnerID.description: The identifier of the company that owns the rig.

IMONumber.title: IMO Number
IMONumber.description: Identification number for the rig provided by International Maritime Organization (IMO).

MPDCapable.title: MPD Capable
MPDCapable.description: Indicates that the rig supports Managed Pressure Drilling

NumJackUpLegs.title: Number Jackup legs
NumJackUpLegs.description: The number of Jackup legs the rig has.

SpudCanDiameter.title: Spud Can Diameter
SpudCanDiameter.description: The diameter of the spud cans.

JackingSystem.title: Jacking System
JackingSystem.description: The system that allows jack-up rigs to elevate their hulls above sea level.

NumThrusters.title: Number Thrusters
NumThrusters.description:
Total number of thrusters supported by the rig.
Thrusters used for dynamic positioning to keep the rig stable in deep water

IsThrusterAzimuth.title: Is Thruster Azimuth
IsThrusterAzimuth.description: Are the thrusters azimuth?  Help maintain stability and position without the need of mooring lines.

DPSystemClass.title: DP System Class
DPSystemClass.description: The Class of the dynamic positioning system.

NumCranes.title: Number of Cranes
NumCranes.description: The number of cranes on the rig

NumGuidelines.title: Number of Guidelines
NumGuidelines.description: Total number of guideline tensioners supported by the rig.

NumTensioners.title: Number of Tensioners
NumTensioners.description:
Total number of riser tensioners supported by the rig.
Tensioners maintain constant tension on the marine riser or drilling equipment, compensating the vertical motion caused by waves and ocean currents

NumAnchor.title: Number or Anchors
NumAnchor.description: Total number of anchors the Rig can accommodate.

DraftTransit.title: Draft Transit
DraftTransit.description: Depth of the vessel below the waterline during transit

DraftOperating.title: Draft Operating
DraftOperating.description: Depth of the vessel below the waterline during operations

HelideckRating.title: Helideck Rating
HelideckRating.description: A description of the type of helicopter the helideck is rated to support. Can also include the dimensions of the helideck.

AccommodationCapacity.title: Accommodation Capacity
AccommodationCapacity.description: Number of people that can be accommodated on the rig.

NumLifeboats.title: Number of Lifeboats
NumLifeboats.description: Number of lifeboats on the rig

MaxWaterDepthRating.title: Maximum Water Depth Rating
MaxWaterDepthRating.description: Maximum water depth for the rig.

MaxDrillingDepthRating.title: Maximum Drilling Depth Rating
MaxDrillingDepthRating.description: Maximum drilling hole depth rating for the rig.

VariableDeckLoadRating.title: Variable Deck Load Rating
VariableDeckLoadRating.description: Maximum allowable weight the rig can safely carry provided by the Rig Owner.

VariableDeckLoadStormRating.title: Variable Deck Load Storm Rating
VariableDeckLoadStormRating.description: Maximum allowable weight the rig can safely carry during a storm provided by the Rig Owner.

FlareTypeID.title: Flare Type ID
FlareTypeID.description:
Description of flare(s).
Suggested types: open flame flare, enclosed flare, smokeless flare

MooringTypeID.title: Mooring Type ID
MooringTypeID.description: Method or system used to secure the rig in it's operational location, either temporary or permanently

MotionCompensationStroke.title: Motion Compensation Stroke
MotionCompensationStroke.description: Length of motion compensation provided by equipment.

HeaveCapacity.title: Heave Capacity
HeaveCapacity.description: Maximum allowable heave on the rig.

DryMudCapacity.title: Dry Mud Capacity
DryMudCapacity.description: Total volume of Bulk/Dry Mud that can be stored on the rig.

LiquidMudCapacity.title: Liquid Mud Capacity
LiquidMudCapacity.description: Total volume for Liquid mud that can be stored, mixed, and processed on the rig

DrillWaterCapacity.title: Drill Water Capacity
DrillWaterCapacity.description: Total volume for Drill water that can be stored for use in various drilling operations. Uses for mud mixing, cooling and cleaning

PotableWaterCapacity.title: Potable Water Capacity
PotableWaterCapacity.description: Total capacity for fresh potable water that can be stored and made available for  consumption and everyday use by the crew, such as drinking, cooking, sanitation, and cleaning

BulkCementCapacity.title: Bulk Cement Capacity
BulkCementCapacity.description: Total volume of cement that can be stored for critical drilling operations like cementing the casing, securing the wellbore, and isolating different formation zones.

FuelCapacity.title: Fuel Capacity
FuelCapacity.description: Total volume of fuel that can be stored and made available on the rig to power its operation, including drilling, generation of electricity, and other essential systems

EnergyStorage.title: Energy Storage
EnergyStorage.description:
Energy Storage System Description.
Systems and technologies used to store energy for operational use, back up power and efficiency optimization like (Compressed air energy storage, Thermal e. st., hydraulic accumulators, Flywheels, batteries)

MainEngine.title: Main Engine
MainEngine.description: The type of engines that provides the primary power source to run essential systems, including drilling operations, power generation, and propulsion

Generator.title: Generator
Generator.description: Description of the electrical power generating system.

AutomationPCROS.title: Automation PCROS
AutomationPCROS.description: Indicates that the rig has a Programmer Control Room Operating System
